available.quote: The board may waive the prescribed examination for licensure and grant a license to any person who shall present proof of current licensure as a dietitian in another state, the District of Columbia, or territory of the United States which requires standards for licensure considered by the advisory council to be greater than or equal to the requirements for licensure of this chapter, if such state or territory extends reciprocity to licensees of the State of Mississippi.

requirements.value: Applicant must present proof of current licensure in another state/DC/territory with standards >= Mississippi's, and that jurisdiction must extend reciprocity to Mississippi licensees.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, corporation or association to, in any manner, represent himself or itself as a dietitian or nutritionist, send out billings as providing services covered in Section 73-10-3(j), or use in connection with his or its name, the titles "dietitian," "dietician" or "nutritionist" or use the letters "LD," "LN" or any other facsimile thereof when he or she is not licensed

scope_protection.quote: the board shall have power to seek injunctive relief to prohibit any person from providing professional dietetic services as defined in Section 73-10-3(1)(j) without being licensed as provided herein.

definition_quote.value: Dietetics is the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food, management and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain peoples' health.
definition_quote.quote: Dietetics is the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food, management and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain peoples' health.

methods_authorized.quote: Dietetics practice is the provision of services which include, but are not limited to: (a) Providing medical nutrition therapy. license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person licensed under this chapter. "Provisionally licensed dietitian" means a person provisionally licensed under this chapter.

provisional_license_available.quote: The board may issue a provisional license to any resident dietitian who presents evidence to the advisory council of the successful completion of the education and experience requirements of subsections (2) and (3) of this section for licensure.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A provisional license may be issued for a period not exceeding one (1) year and may be renewed from year to year not to exceed five (5) years.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A provisional license shall permit the holder to practice only under the direct technical supervision of a dietitian.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: Any person providing dietetic services, including but not limited to dietetic technicians, dietetic assistants and dietary managers, from practicing dietetics while working under the direct technical supervision of a licensed dietician.

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: Applicants shall provide evidence of current registration as a registered dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: "Specialized nutrition therapies" mean medical foods, enteral nutrition delivered via tube, or parenteral nutrition delivered by intravenous infusion.

direct_supervision_defined.quote: "Direct, technical supervision" means the direct, technical supervision by a licensed dietitian, as prescribed in regulations by the board, of the dietetics practice or medical nutrition therapy provided to an individual and/or group by a provisionally licensed dietitian.

exempt_professions_list.quote: This chapter shall not be construed to affect or prevent: (a) A student enrolled in an approved academic program in dietetics ... (b) Any person fulfilling the experience requirements ... (c) A registered dietitian who is serving in the Armed Forces or the Public Health Service ... (d) Any person providing dietetic services, including but not limited to dietetic technicians, dietetic assistants and dietary managers ... (e) Persons licensed or registered to practice the health professions ... (f) Persons who perform the activities and services of a nutrition educator in the employ of a federal, state, county or municipal agency ... (g) Federal, state, county or local government employees involved with programs providing the services of a nutrition educator ... (h) Individuals who do not hold themselves out to be dietitians from marketing or distributing food products including dietary supplements ... (i) Any person from furnishing general nutrition information ...

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A registered dietitian who is serving in the Armed Forces or the Public Health Service of the United States or is employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs from engaging in the practice of dietetics provided such practice is restricted to such service or employment.

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: Individuals who do not hold themselves out to be dietitians from marketing or distributing food products including dietary supplements as defined by the Food and Drug Administration or from engaging in the explanation and education of customers regarding the use of such products.

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: A nonresident dietitian may practice dietetics in Mississippi for five (5) days per year with current other state's licensure or with current registration with the Commission on Dietetics Registration.

nonresident_temporary_practice_max_days.quote: A nonresident dietitian may practice dietetics in Mississippi for five (5) days per year with current other state's licensure or with current registration with the Commission on Dietetics Registration.
